scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II
description:
The Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II was launched by the Government of Tamil Nadu on 1st April 2021. 

This scheme is a continuation of the original Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme which was initiated in 2006. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance for the marriage of girls belonging to economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme aims to empower women by alleviating the financial burden associated with marriage. 

Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹50,000 is provided for the marriage of a girl. 

This amount is intended to cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony. 

The assistance is specifically targeted at girls who have completed their education. 

The scheme encourages families to prioritize the education of girls before marriage. 

To be eligible for this scheme, the girl must be a resident of Tamil Nadu. 

The girl must belong to a family with an annual income not exceeding ₹2.5 lakh. 

The scheme is applicable to girls who are aged between 18 and 30 years at the time of marriage. 

The applicant must provide proof of age through a birth certificate or any government-issued ID. 

Additionally, the girl must have completed at least the 10th standard of education. 

This educational requirement is aimed at promoting the importance of education among girls. 

The application process for the scheme is straightforward and involves several steps. 

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the official website or the local office of the Department of Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme. 

The completed application form must be submitted along with the required documents. 

Documents required include proof of age, proof of income, and educational qualification certificates. 

A marriage invitation card may also be required to validate the marriage date. 

Once the application is submitted, it is verified by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the applicant. 

The disbursement is usually done within a month after the verification process is completed. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Programme of Tamil Nadu. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the department at their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is 1800 425 5901. 

The scheme is part of the broader initiative by the Tamil Nadu government to promote women's welfare and empowerment. 

It is also aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals set by the United Nations, particularly Goal 5 which focuses on gender equality. 

The government has allocated a significant budget for the implementation of this scheme. 

In the financial year 2021-2022, the Tamil Nadu government allocated ₹200 crore for the Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II. 

This allocation is expected to benefit thousands of girls across the state. 

The scheme has been well received by the public, with many families expressing gratitude for the financial assistance. 

It is estimated that approximately 40,000 girls will benefit from this scheme annually. 

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also aims to change societal perceptions regarding the marriage of educated girls. 

By promoting education and financial independence, the scheme seeks to empower women in Tamil Nadu. 

The government has also launched awareness campaigns to inform families about the benefits of the scheme. 

These campaigns are conducted through various media channels including television, radio, and social media platforms. 

The Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II is a significant step towards reducing child marriage and promoting women's rights. 

The scheme has been instrumental in encouraging families to invest in the education of their daughters. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is a crucial support for families who may struggle with marriage expenses. 

The scheme is also a part of the government's commitment to ensuring social justice and equality. 

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme promotes the idea of responsible parenting and planning for daughters' futures. 

The government regularly reviews and updates the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the implementation process. 

The Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II is a vital initiative in Tamil Nadu's welfare landscape. 

It reflects the government's dedication to enhancing the status of women in society. 

The scheme is a model for other states to consider in their efforts to promote women's empowerment. 

Overall, the Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II is a comprehensive program aimed at supporting girls and their families during a significant life event. 

It stands as a testament to the Tamil Nadu government's commitment to social welfare and gender equality.
